name: UOAREIT
recent: UOAREIT 近期出现董事局与审计委员会人事变动，并公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。此外，公司于 11 月 17 日披露每单位净资产值。
notable: 董事局出现人事变动，Stephanie Kong Pei Zen 离任。
Yap Kang Beng 获委任进入审计委员会，并出现董事局变动。
公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。

recent_en: UOAREIT recently saw boardroom and audit committee changes and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. It also disclosed its net asset value per unit on 17 November.
notable_en: Boardroom change with the departure of Stephanie Kong Pei Zen.
Yap Kang Beng was appointed to the Audit Committee, alongside a boardroom change.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
